levels.description: The grand trial: navigate obstacles, cast RGB light, and chant the opening phrase.
levels.objective:
1. Pick up the Key at (2, 1) and put it into the Lock Flask at (2, 5)
2. Navigate to the Brazier at (5, 3) and cast hero.cast_color(255, 0, 0)
3. Walk to the Gate at (10, 3) and chant: print(f'Open, {spell}!')
levels.starter_code:

# Combine: Movement + Variables + Flasks + RGB Light + f-strings!

spell = "The Prism Gate"

# Step 1: Collect the Key at (2, 1) and deposit it into the 'str' Lock Flask at (2, 5)
hero.move_right(2)
hero.move_up(2)
hero.pick_up()
hero.move_down(4)
hero.put_in("str")

# Step 2: Navigate around the stone wall to the Brazier at (5, 3) and cast Red light
hero.move_up(2)
hero.move_right(3)
hero.cast_color(255, 0, 0)

# Step 3: Move to the Gate at (10, 3) and chant using f-string
hero.move_right(5)
print(f"Open, {spell}!")
